items.question: List resolutions that reference five or more TDocs (multi-document decisions).
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) WITH r, collect(t.tdocNumber) AS refs, count(t) AS cnt WHERE cnt >= 5 MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, refs[..5] AS top5_refs, cnt ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, cnt DESC LIMIT 10
